site.homeDescription: Notes, ideas, and moments from Yom.

home.headlineEnd: that won’t fit in a caption.
home.intro: I’m Yom — a curious human collecting ideas, projects, and little observations from the way through.

writing.intro: Ideas, observations, and works in progress — all gathered in one place.

about.intro: I make things for the internet and write about the bits that make me pause.
about.cardTitle: This is my small corner of the internet.
about.body: I use it to share what I’m exploring — projects, questions, ideas, and the occasional unfinished thought. No performance, just the good stuff.

contact.intro: For a project, a thoughtful question, or simply a hello — my inbox is open.

pictures.intro: Photographs and sketches collected here, each with a note about why I kept it.

items.title: Blue hour, no signal
items.caption: The ten minutes after sunset when the street looks like it belongs to a film.
items.context: Took this while walking home. The kind of quiet that only lasts a few weeks a year.

items.title: Desk, mid-thought
items.caption: An interface idea I sketched on the back of a receipt.
items.context: Drew this to test a layout idea I could not get out of my head. Still not sure it works, still not willing to throw it away.

items.title: This site, day one
items.caption: Screenshot of the very first version of this corner of the internet.
items.context: Saved before I started rewriting everything. A reminder that finished is a choice, not a requirement.

progress.intro: Loose goals I’m working towards. Percentages are honest, not aspirational.

entries.title: I’m learning to leave room for wonder.
entries.excerpt: Somewhere between building things and becoming someone, I found a quieter kind of ambition.

entries.title: A small collection of things I’m drawn to lately.
entries.excerpt: Blue hour walks, interfaces with a point of view, and making space to be delightfully curious.

entries.title: On making the internet feel a little more human.
entries.excerpt: The corners of the web I love most still feel like someone left the light on just for you.
